component.name: corMani
component.summary: Mail, calendar and correspondence across every channel

description.p: corMani is a desktop correspondence client. It handles many mail accounts at once over IMAP and SMTP, with calendars alongside them, and keeps track of which conversations are owed a reply and which carry a deadline that cannot slip.

Messaging services that publish no interface for personal conversations — WhatsApp, LinkedIn, X, Facebook — appear as panels in the same window, so that everything arrives in one place even where integration is not possible. corMani is honest about the difference: it never presents a panel as though its contents were searchable.

ul.li: Many accounts, unified or separately, with an order you choose
Full-text search across every message, offline
Threading that survives a correspondent changing the subject
Calendars, read and write, with invitations answerable in place
Credentials in the system keyring, never on disk
Remote content in a message blocked until you ask for it

description.p: Foundations: packaging, storage, configuration and the application shell.
